basic_info.description:
Step into this stunning 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom sanctuary nestled in one of the world's most vibrant cities. Perfectly blending elegance with modern convenience, this residence redefines comfortable living. With direct elevator access to your unit, youll find convenience at every turn. 
The heart of the home is its spacious chefs kitchen, a culinary haven featuring premium appliances: a gas cooktop, built-in oven, self-cleaning oven, gas oven range, and refrigerator. Whether you're entertaining or enjoying cozy family nights, the open-concept family room, living room, and kitchen provide an ideal space for connection and relaxation.
Set within a well-managed boutique building, you'll enjoy tranquil views of Lone Mountain and St. Ignatiusadding an element of serenity to city living. Luxurious touches like hardwood floors, a gas fireplace, and ample closet space ensure both style and functionality. In-unit laundry, access to a large shared deck and garden, and garage parking add everyday ease to your lifestyle.
Located just a half block from Rossi Playground and Pool, and only moments from the iconic Golden Gate Park, Presidio, USF, Clement Streets vibrant dining scene, and a lively Sunday farmers market, this home promises an experience thats as practical as it is unforgettable.
